name: [R8🥳] Generic Tycoon Game
desc:
👑 Welcome to The Tycoon Game! 👑
A straightforward tycoon game with 850+ buttons. Build your factory from scratch, buy cash droppers, and unlock upgraders to increase your money loop! 💸

🛠️ OVER 800+ UNIQUE BUTTONS: This isn't a short 150-button map. It features a long-term progression loop with hundreds of unlocks, custom droppers, and factory expansions.
🍎 CRAFTING & EXPLORATION: Explore the map to find different kinds of consumables. Use them to accelerate your progress!
🔄 REBIRTHS: Every rebirth unlocks new areas and gives permanent money bonuses and buttons!

🐸 GAME PERKS:
• Join the Lusman's Game Group to unlock frog-themed buttons.
• Roblox Premium players get a permanent +2 cash bonus.
• Private VIP servers are 100% free for everyone to reduce lag (tho fruit drop rates may be lowered).

[⚠️ Updates take time to develop, so expect delays between content drops. Thanks for playing!]
